name: MELEWAR
recent: MELEWAR 将于 2026 年 12 月 2 日召开第 57 届常年股东大会，议程包括续期 10% 股份回购授权及关联交易授权。主席 Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra 在闭门期前申报拟交易意向，并于 11 月 13 日以 5,148 令吉增持 42,900 股。公司同时发布了 2026 年报及截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。
notable: 主席 Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日以 5,148 令吉增持 42,900 股普通股。
公司发布 2026 年报，并订于 2026 年 12 月 2 日召开第 57 届常年股东大会。
股东大会将表决续期 10% 股份回购授权及关联交易授权。
risks: 主席在闭门期前申报拟交易意向，随后于闭门期内增持股份。

recent_en: Chairman Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra declared intention to deal during the closed period and acquired 42,900 shares for MYR 5,148 on 13 November. The company also released its 2026 Annual Report and quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Chairman Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra acquired 42,900 ordinary shares for MYR 5,148 on 13 November 2026.
The company released its 2026 Annual Report and scheduled its 57th AGM for 2 December 2026.
risks_en: The Chairman declared intention to deal during the closed period and subsequently acquired shares within the closed period.
